Container.Name: strata-twr03
Container.Overview: Strata, the fleet's coding model: Qwen3.8 Flash-Next Coder (pack IQ1_M) at 256K context on Tower03's FIRST RTX 5060 Ti only. Always loaded; uses about 61 GB of system RAM. OpenAI-compatible API at http://10.47.40.129:8080. The API key lives in the data folder (state/api-key), not in this template. The second 5060 Ti belongs to image generation (ComfyUI, Invoke-AI) and must not be added here. Measured 2026-11-16: 85-109 tok/s; first load after a restart can take about 7 minutes.

Config.Name: API Port
Config.Description: Strata listens here on the container's own IP (10.47.40.129).

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Model packs, install, state and the API key.

Config.Name: Model pack
Config.Description: IQ1_M is the pack chosen for one 16 GB card (about 61 GB RAM). IQ3_S needs about 84 GB RAM.

Config.Name: Card index
Config.Description: Index among the cards this container can see. With one card visible this is 0.

Config.Name: Context
Config.Description: Context window: 32k, 64k, 128k or 256k. RAM use is about the same at 128k and 256k.

Config.Name: NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES
Config.Description: GPU UUID (nvidia-smi -L). The FIRST RTX 5060 Ti only.
